assessment: Applicable commercial interventions exist; public data do not establish a remaining, fund-additional, bankable companywide abatement total.

baseline.boundary: GSCC hot-rolled steel, Scopes 1, 2, 3; not corporate enterprise or SASB cast steel

scenario.kind: normalized target-achievement scenario, not independent engineering forecast
scenario.output_status: analyst normalization, not actual facility production or uptake percentage
scenario.rollout: company 2030 target achieved and maintained in 2031, conditional on implementation

historic_roadmap_reference.warning: Do not treat historic waterfall as remaining 2025 gap or add it to current reductions.

interventions.name: Furnace efficiency: reheat optimization and EAF carbon delivery
interventions.commercial_status: demonstrated at Nucor Seattle; commercial controls and injectors; further site eligibility unknown

measured_evidence.boundary: furnace consumption and energy cost per source-defined ton

measured_evidence.unit_note: source cast ton convention not normalized to metric tonne

interventions.alternative: Scrap preheat: S4 Charter comparator reports17%energy saving and nearly USD4m/year savings; not transferable to Nucor and not additive to controls.
interventions.rollout_by_2031: Only named unoptimized assets passing metallurgical and net-savings trials; no numerical uptake assumed.
interventions.cashflow: Avoided electricity, gas and carbon purchases less maintenance/compressed-air/outage costs.
constraints: existing Seattle installations excluded from new additionality

interventions.name: Additional cleaner electricity
interventions.rollout_by_2031: Further interconnectable renewables/onsite projects and utility arrangements, after residual-load and contract review; fusion excluded.
interventions.accounting: REC-based market inventory changes distinct from marginal physical emissions. Use hourly relevant geography and forward grid scenarios, S7.
interventions.cashflow: Power sales to project owner or verified delivered tariff savings; VPPA settlement risk can be negative.

interventions.name: Low-copper scrap and qualified lower-carbon iron feedstock
interventions.factor_status: combined company projection; individual scrap-versus-pig-iron share not disclosed
interventions.deployment: Nucor Berkeley low-copper shred; Bushnell nonferrous recovery separately demonstrated
interventions.rollout_by_2031: Only quality-qualified, traceable additional throughput that displaces measured virgin metallic inputs.
interventions.cashflow: Avoided metallics cost plus saleable copper net processing/yield/logistics costs; data unavailable.
constraints: copper and tramp-element limits differ by grade
virgin substitution ratio not1:1 by default

interventions.name: Louisiana natural-gas DRI capture
interventions.status: contract signed2023; startup expected2026 in latest retrieved status; annual operation not established
interventions.rollout_by_2031: Deliver and verify existing project, not a new unspecified expansion.
interventions.cashflow: Needs contracted payments, verified eligible incentives or enforceable premium; no assumed cash savings or tax-credit amounts.
interventions.investor_additionality: No credit for already contracted capacity unless financing demonstrably changes timing/scope.
constraints: plant capture and steel-product roadmap factors cannot be added
